claim_text: The Funk complaint alleges roughly $1 billion in grading-related fees/losses over the proposed period and pursues civil RICO relief.

claim_text: 18 U.S.C. § 1964(c) provides threefold damages for qualifying injury sustained by a successful civil RICO plaintiff.

claim_text: A $3 billion figure is a theoretical treble-damages framing derived from an approximately $1 billion alleged base; it is not an award, judgment, settlement, certified classwide damages model, or guaranteed recovery.
